column1: # NOTE: bins > 750 bp lack calibration data (yeast introns max ~800 bp in this chunk).
#   750 bp–5 kb: kept at 22 bp (empirically calibrated 5th-percentile from ≤750 bp bins,
#   extended flat; many exon-1's are 20–34 nt so 22 bp is the defensible floor without
#   penalising reads starting close to long-intron boundaries).
#   > 5 kb: 50 bp; quality check (hp_ed/overhang_bases < 20%) in corrected_consensus.py
#   provides the main discrimination for chimeric gapmm2/deSALT artifacts at this range.
